maintenance_led.reason: Sells Portland and masonry cement plus ready-mixed concrete for new construction, not repair or replacement of installed items.

publicly_funded.reason: Cement and concrete go mainly to private contractors, ready-mix producers and masonry builders; public road work is only a part.

serial_acquirer.reason: Grows mainly by producing and selling cement and concrete from its own Kansas plant; no steady acquisition roll-up.

mission_critical.reason: Portland and masonry cement are largely commodity materials that buyers can source from other regional cement suppliers.

notes: Public funding share is uncertain; highway work is part of demand but likely not the majority.
